title: Sensorimotor Vestibular Recalibration & Dynamic Gait Assistance
plain_language_summary: Post-transition postural sway velocity, gait asymmetry index, or psychomotor response latency demonstrates incomplete adaptation.
crew_instructions: Perform 15-minute guided Vestibulo-Ocular Reflex (VOR) gaze fixation training using the visual calibration helmet.
Utilize dual handrail support during intra-vehicular transit until postural sway stabilization index > 0.80.
Execute active closed-chain ankle/knee proprioceptive loading drills on the countermeasure vibration plate.
Re-run 3-minute Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) before engaging in EVAs or robotic manipulator operations.
de_escalation_criteria: Gait asymmetry < 8%, postural sway velocity within 1.5 sigma of pre-transition nominal, zero gaze instability.
